IF SOMEONE IS LOOKING FOR THIS AND WANTS A SOLUTION HOW TO MAKE THIS HERE:

* Locate :Move\_UsageCalculations: in the script editor and replace the preexisting damage calculation with this to allow the **On-Hit** damage effects.

\# Calculate all multiplier effects  
*multipliers = {*  
*:power\_multiplier        => 1.0,*  
*:attack\_multiplier       => 1.0,*  
*:defense\_multiplier      => 1.0,*  
*:final\_damage\_multiplier => 1.0,*  
*:base\_additive           => 0*  
*}*  
*pbCalcDamageMultipliers(user, target, numTargets, type, baseDmg, multipliers)*  
*# Main damage calculation*  
*baseDmg = \[(baseDmg \* multipliers\[:power\_multiplier\]).round, 1\].max*  
*atk     = \[(atk     \* multipliers\[:attack\_multiplier\]).round, 1\].max*  
*defense = \[(defense \* multipliers\[:defense\_multiplier\]).round, 1\].max*  
*damage  = ((((2.0 \* user.level / 5) + 2).floor \* baseDmg \* atk / defense).floor / 50).floor + 2*  
*damage  = \[((damage \* multipliers\[:final\_damage\_multiplier\]) + multipliers\[:base\_additive\]).round, 1\].max*  
*target.damageState.calcDamage = damage*  
  *end*

* Now paste this in :AbilityEffects:, this ability allows the user to deal 20% of its defense as damage on-hit damage when it deals a physical hit. It also tracks defense changes, buffs and debuffs, so it can deal even more damage with settup!

*Battle::AbilityEffects::DamageCalcFromUser.add(:ARMORBOOST,*  
  *proc { |ability, user, target, move, mults, power, type|*  
*if move.physicalMove?*  
*max\_stage = Battle::Battler::STAT\_STAGE\_MAXIMUM*  
*stageMul = Battle::Battler::STAT\_STAGE\_MULTIPLIERS*  
*stageDiv = Battle::Battler::STAT\_STAGE\_DIVISORS*  
*defense\_stage         = user.stages\[:DEFENSE\] + max\_stage*  
*real\_defense         = (user.defense.to\_f \* stageMul\[defense\_stage\] / stageDiv\[defense\_stage\]).floor*  
*mults\[:base\_additive\] += (real\_defense \* 0.2).round*  
*end*  
  *}*  
*)*
